status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 47% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 47 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iranian-backed militias in Iraq experienced a mysterious explosion that struck a group linked to Iran, while the Popular Mobilization Forces confirmed Al-Fayyadh remains chairman despite disputed vice-presidency claims. Security tensions rose as Iran’s envoy warned that the security of Iran-Iraq borders is Tehran’s red line and Iran attacked the Komala Kurdish opposition group in Iraq. In the north, a power struggle in Nineveh delayed Sinjar administrative appointments and the Kurdistan Regional Government warned a coalition exit could enable an ISIS resurgence. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iransk-støttede militsgrupper i Irak opplevde en mystisk eksplosjon som rammet en gruppe knyttet til Iran, mens Folkebevegelsens styrker bekreftet at Al-Fayyadh fortsatt er styreleder til tross for omstridte påstander om visepresidentrollen. Sikkerhetsspenningsnivået økte da Irans utsending advarte om at sikkerheten ved Iran-Irak-grensen er Tehrans røde linje, og Iran angrep den kurdiske opposisjonsgruppen Komala i Irak. I nord ble en maktkamp i Nineve forsinket i utnevnelsen av administrativt ansvar i Sinjar, og den kurdiske regionale regjeringen advarte om at et uttrekksalternativ fra koalisjonen kan muliggjøre en gjenoppblussing av IS. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
